record.context_brief: Automorphism group of the putative [72,36,16] Type II code
record.original_question: Assuming a binary Type II self-dual [72, 36, 16] code exists, prove that its automorphism group is trivial.

evidence.quote: Open Question 7.6. Show that the automorphism group of a putative [72, 36, 16] Type II code is trivial.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A binary linear code of length $n$ is a linear subspace $C \subseteq \mathbb{F}_2^n$. The code $C$ is called self-dual if $C = C^\perp$ with respect to the standard inner product on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and it is called Type II (doubly-even) if it is self-dual and the Hamming weight of every codeword is divisible by $4$. The minimum distance of $C$ is $d(C) = \min\{\mathrm{wt}(c) : c \in C, c \neq 0\}$. The automorphism group $\mathrm{Aut}(C)$ consists of all coordinate permutations $\sigma \in S_n$ such that $\sigma(C) = C$.

Assume that a binary Type II self-dual code $C$ of length $72$, dimension $36$, and minimum distance $16$ exists. Prove that $\mathrm{Aut}(C)$ is trivial, i.e. $\mathrm{Aut}(C) = \{1\}$.
artifact.status_search_result: A sequence of works has progressively restricted the automorphism group of a putative extremal Type II [72,36,16] binary code. It has been shown that the group cannot contain various subgroups (S_3, A_4, D_8, Z_2×Z_4, Q_8, Z_10) and is not elementary abelian of order 8. Combining these results, Aut(C) has order at most 5; it is now known to be cyclic of order 1, 2, 3, or 5. The full conjecture that the automorphism group is trivial has not been established.

status_evidence.title: The Automorphism Group of an Extremal [72,36,16] Code
status_evidence.snippet: Aut(C) has order at most 5 or is isomorphic to the elementary abelian group of order 8.
status_evidence.claim: The automorphism group is heavily restricted but not yet proven trivial.

status_evidence.title: The automorphism group of a self-dual [72,36,16] code is not an elementary abelian group of order 8
status_evidence.snippet: Aut(C) is not isomorphic to the elementary abelian group of order 8; combining with prior results, |Aut(C)| ≤ 5.
status_evidence.claim: Current best bound is |Aut(C)| ≤ 5; not yet proven trivial.

status_evidence.title: An extremal [72,36,16] binary code has no automorphism group containing Z2×Z4, Q8, or Z10
status_evidence.snippet: Various candidate subgroups are excluded from Aut(C).
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress restricting possible automorphism groups.
